newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares decline undramatically,recovery seen.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares decline undramatically,recovery seen.

text.p: Danish share prices closed slightly lower on Friday ending a run of record closing highs, but prevented from falling further by the strong dollar, with dealers seeing possible recovery next week.

"The strong dollar helped the index from slipping further, bolstering dollar-sensitive Moeller shipping against dramatic declines which could have sent the index lower. As usual these days, After morning rises the market fell, we could well see a recovery on Monday though," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.74 point down at 144.78 in overall bourse turnover of 1.925 billion crowns.
The KFX March future fell 1.55 point to 144.85 with 242 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Moeller's D/S 1912 B shed 4,000 crowns to close at 175,000 crowns, while twin share D/S Svendborg B finished 666 crowns up at 257,666.
ISS only lost one crown to end the day at 146 after announcing the completion of its divestment of troubled U.S. unit ISS Inc. for an unspecified "modest" price.
kFK rose five crowns to 255 despite reduced expectations for 1996.
